caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical bronze or dark brown metallic object, possibly a container or decorative item, with a sculptural group positioned on top. The sculptural group consists of three human figures standing closely together in a circular arrangement, each dressed in historical or traditional attire with long cloaks and wide-brimmed hats. The figures are detailed and three-dimensional, with one at the front facing directly outward and the other two positioned slightly behind and to each side, all with visible facial features and individual postures. Above the figures, an elongated vertical element rises upward, ending in a loop, possibly for hanging or attaching. The cylindrical base has a horizontal band near the top and bottom and a rectangular relief panel on the front depicting a scene with a sailing ship on water and possible additional figures or details rendered in shallow relief. The color palette consists mainly of rich, dark browns with some lighter highlights to indicate metallic surfaces and volume. The artist's name, Joseph Cannella, is written in small letters at the bottom right of the composition. The background is plain, off-white with some scattered visible specks.
title: Tobacco Jar
